responsibility: Owns the core rustc_smir conversion infrastructure: the Tables interning state that maps rustc entities to stable IDs, utility functions for crate and item classification, and the Stable trait that all rustc-to-stable conversions implement.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `stable_mir/mod.rs`, which defines the public, compiler-agnostic API and thread-local dispatch trait, this module is the rustc-backed implementation of that trait: `Tables` stores `TyCtxt`, `DefId`, and type interning state, and the `Stable` trait lowers rustc MIR/types into stable forms. Unlike `rustc_internal/mod.rs`, it does not expose reverse lookups or the external escape-hatch API for recovering rustc internals from stable handles.
